# Binary fixtures

`octets.bin` is a self-authored, exactly 256-byte fixture. Byte at offset `i`
is `i`, for every value from 0 through 255. It includes NUL, CR, LF, and bytes
that are not valid UTF-8. There is no external corpus or license dependency.

SHA-256:
`40aff2e9d2d8922e47afd4648e6967497158785fbd1da870e7110266bf944880`.

The sequence can be regenerated byte-exactly on Windows:

```powershell
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes(
    'C:\Source\Moss\tests\fixtures\octets.bin',
    [byte[]](0..255)
)
```

The native test target validates all 256 values before using this fixture
to construct signed/unsigned extrema. It uses `byteToString` on these bytes;
no unsupported Joyeer Int-to-UInt8 conversion or string escape is assumed.

Large acquisition fixtures are generated during the tests in exclusively
created files directly under the existing, ignored `target` directory.
Only successfully claimed files are removed. Tests never create or
recursively delete temporary directories.

`jvm/Fixtures.jar` packages `Example8.class` (DEFLATE), `Example21.class` (STORE), and
`Unicode.class` (DEFLATE) under `pkg/`, plus a manifest and a directory entry. It is
built from the checked-in classes with Python `zipfile`; the bytes are not otherwise
significant.
